tharwyn_1.m: Hello there. I heard you helped Jolnor in the chapel. You have my thanks, friend.

tharwyn_2.m: Have a seat anywhere. What can I get you?
r: Show me what food you have available.
Torilo suggested that I ask other tavern owners such as yourself about a 'business agreement' that you may have with a group of 'distributors'.
Let's get back to discussing your 'business agreement' with the 'distributors'.

tharwyn_beer.m: What? I don't know anything about what you speak of.
r: I am sure you do. What do I have to do to hear what you know?

tharwyn_beer_10.m: Well, if I read you correctly, I feel like you are prepared to offer me a bribe?
r: Oh great, not another tavern owner hungry for more gold.
If that's what it it takes to get you to talk, then yes.

tharwyn_beer_30.m: Wow! This is my lucky day. I just found out today that my daughter needs {5000} gold in order to enroll at this special school in Nor City and now here you are offering me a bribe.

r: What? You guys are killing me.
That sounds ridiculous, but here, take it.
That sounds ridiculous! I won't pay that much.

tharwyn_beer_50.m: I will not get into the 'business agreement' part of this deal, but I will tell you about the 'distributors'.

tharwyn_beer_51.m: That's fine with me, but no information for you.

tharwyn_beer_60.m: Do you see that suspicious looking fellow over there in the corner?

tharwyn_beer_70.m: That is Dunla. He gets me my beer. Go talk to him.

vilegard_shop_notrust.m: You are an outsider. We don't like outsiders here in Vilegard. Please leave.
r: Why is everyone in Vilegard so suspicious of outsiders?
Can I see what items you have for sale?

vilegard_shop_notrust_2.m: I don't trust you. You should go see Jolnor in the chapel if you want some sympathy.
